Application Data.NAME: Paving Solutions, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Paving Solutions, Inc. specializes in providing high-quality asphalt and paving services for residential and commercial projects. Our operations include site preparation, asphalt laying, and paving repairs, utilizing state-of-the-art equipment and skilled personnel. We prioritize safety and efficiency, adhering to rigorous maintenance schedules for all machinery and following industry best practices to minimize environmental impact. Our team is trained in handling hazardous materials and complies with all relevant environmental regulations. We emphasize customer satisfaction and reliable project delivery, despite potential seasonal weather impacts.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On June 15, 2023, Paving Solutions, Inc. experienced a loss due to a heavy rainstorm that caused significant delays to a scheduled asphalt paving project. The estimated cost of the delays, including labor and material rescheduling, amounted to $10,500. The loss is currently being processed and is under review with our financial team.

Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around job sites, along with trained watch personnel during after-hours operations to deter theft and vandalism.
